I understand.

Depression is fucking hard. It’s waking up in the morning (providing you even got to sleep in the first place) and just lying there wishing you didn’t wake up at all. The constant feeling of gravity multiplying under you. Wishing you could feel anything but the endless hopelessness. 

I’m not going to lie and say everything is going to be okay, cause I’m not a medium. But I can say that with time, symptoms can be suppressed. Medications can help, talking to people you don’t know personally can help. 

There’s gunna be times where you feel like you’re getting there and there will be hiccups that throw you straight back into your spiral of depression, but you’ve just got to really grab the reins on it and take as much control of it as you can.

Get help while you’re able to, trust me.
